title: Contradictory Statements — Sleep Duration
description: Patient gives conflicting information about sleep and current functioning

conversation.content: Thank you for being here. What brings you to seek support today?
I've been having a really hard time with anxiety. It's been months of worrying about everything.
How has the anxiety been affecting your sleep?
Oh I sleep fine actually. Sleep is the one thing that's okay.
That's good to hear. How is the anxiety affecting your work or daily activities?
I'm barely functioning. I can't concentrate, I'm exhausted all the time because I'm not sleeping enough.
Earlier you mentioned sleep was okay — can you tell me more about your sleep? How many hours are you getting?
Oh, I mean I lie in bed a lot but I'm awake most of the night. Maybe 2 or 3 hours actually. But I always say sleep is fine because I don't want to complain.
Thank you for clarifying. Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself?
No, nothing like that. I want to get better.
Do you have support from family or friends?
My partner is very supportive. That helps a lot.
